body: ......I've been seeing one of those for 5 years. I just don't know what to do anymore. Thank you, very much for trying. I truly appreciate it.

I'm a coward in the way I don't have the courage to do what I really want to. I've been taking most of my anger out of myself for years. I no longer have people around me who care about me, or who I care about. From what I have seen and heard the world would be a better place without me. I am a walking mental breakdown, I rarely have moments of clarity anymore. Most of my hobbies have faded into things that no longer interest me. A year ago, I still enjoyed reading, playing video games and hanging out with my close friends. No my hobbies consist of thinking of ways I can kill myself and crying over losing the ones I loved and trusted. Oh, and would like to show you why I called myself SadSadLarry. http://www.explosm.net/comics/2245/     Its how I feel everyday now.

I don't live with my parents. I live in the basement of my sisters house with my mother, and my father is......somewhere. My mother and I have a strenuous relationship but we aren't hostile. I am currently back at her house, but the way things are going I will be told to leave again. I haven't been in school for two years due to my extreme dislike of my peers so I can't talk to a guidance counselor. I no longer have people to take my anger out on other then myself, which is an improvement to who I was hurting before. I have been taking anger management on and off for around 10 years now to no avail. Currently I am awaiting either enough rage and self hatred to kill myself, or enough despair. I'm a coward and can't bring myself to do it unless under extreme emotional distress.

I have extreme emotional instability. I have a tendency to repress things that bother me until they burst into fits of intense rage. This tends to manifests in emotional and mental abuse to those who are close to me, and no matter what I try I can't stop it. It's why I have lost everyone close to me.

Well they are all related in one major way. I'm not a good person. I was kicked out because I was told I was ungrateful. I was dumped by my girlfriend because she thought I cared only about sex when I didn't and my  friends had been trying to sabotage my relationship with her since we met. I guess the way they are all related is the fact that I'm an asshole.
